title: campanula fenestrellata subsp. debarensis
intro: Campanula fenestrellata subsp. debarensis, commonly known as Alpine bellflower, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the family Campanulaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Alpine bellflower are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Campanula fenestrellata subsp. debarensis may also contribute to its potential use in traditional medicine, particularly in the treatment of gastrointestinal and respiratory disorders.
